Tootdflow digital magnifier is made for adults, seniors, hobbyists, and DIY users who need to read small print or inspect fine details at home, at a desk, or in a workshop. It combines a 2-inch IPS screen, 10-200X cyclic zoom, a detachable lens shield, dual-color lighting, photo capture, and Type-C charging in one portable tool, so you can view details on screen instead of holding a small handheld magnifier close to your eyes

When reading medicine labels, manuals, receipts, or newspaper small print on a flat surface, place the lens shield over the page and adjust the distance until the image is clear. The shield helps set a consistent working distance and find focus quickly on flat items; for uneven or irregular surfaces, remove the shield and adjust the distance by hand while viewing the 2-inch IPS screen

For coins, stamps, jewelry, model parts, or collectible details, use the plus button to zoom through the 10-200X cycle and switch the dual-color light. Three white-light levels brighten surface details, and the UV mode helps inspect fluorescent marks and security details on many collectibles. On uneven objects, remove the lens shield first so you can bring the magnifier closer to the area you want to inspect

For soldering, watch repair, sewing, crafts, or plant and fabric inspection, the matte non-slip body and included lanyard keep the magnifier easy to hold at a workbench. The 500mAh battery supports Type-C charging, and the lens shield helps protect the lens when the tool is set down; remove it when the surface is not flat or when you need more flexibility in viewing distance

Capture up to 100 photos onboard for quick records of serial numbers, labels, repair steps, or collection details. Photo capture works directly, and you can connect the magnifier to a computer to transfer files or view the live screen for a larger shared view; video recording requires a separately sold microSD card that is not included

Many simple handheld magnifiers require you to hold the lens close, offer one light setting, and cannot save a photo; compact digital magnifiers may have small screens, limited lighting options, or a focus process that takes extra time. Tootdflow combines a 2-inch IPS screen, a detachable lens shield for flat-surface viewing, white and UV lighting, photo capture, and Type-C charging for a more complete reading and inspection experience

Package includes the digital magnifier, user manual, lanyard, Type-C cable, and lens shield. Use the lens shield on flat items to help set a consistent focus distance; remove it for uneven surfaces and adjust the distance by hand. Photo capture is ready to use; video recording requires a separately sold microSD card (not included). The LED light is an illumination light, so keep it on for magnified viewing. Designed for everyday reading and inspection, not as a medical device
